name: Firaga
doc: Firaga (the spell): the root and one director an action on its target - the area flames, the flame swirls, the fireball, the burst and sparks, the screen flash, the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag143_firaga.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: One director an action on its target: the area flames, the flame swirls, the fireball, the burst and sparks, the screen flash, the sound; the damage

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage at this tick of an action's director

params.label: Area flame
params.doc: The sprite sequence area flame (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Burst model
params.doc: The prim model burst (a mesh of 72 vertices, 48 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Flame swirl model
params.doc: The prim model flame swirl (a mesh of 162 vertices, 320 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Fireball model
params.doc: The prim model fireball (a mesh of 73 vertices, 72 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Spark model
params.doc: The prim model spark (a mesh of 31 vertices, 30 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))
